name: Saku (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Saku city emblem in green: a stylised bird-like device with a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Saku, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 2005.

features.role: Saku city emblem — a stylised bird-like device with a ring
